_comment: Removed a fabricated STATIC_TRIGGERED ON_DEFEND -> INTIMIDATE ability: the card has no intimidate text. The generator hallucinated it from Blade Break equipment (27 cards corpus-wide). Repaired invalid condition types exposed when OR/AND stopped silently swallowing sub-conditions authored under "conditions": ATTACK_ACTION -> ATTACK_TYPE_IN; BASE_POWER_LTE -> ATTACK_BASE_POWER_LTE. Removed a plain STATIC holding MODIFY_ATTACK +1 and a WARD the card does not have. NOT IMPLEMENTED: 'The SECOND attack action card with 2 or less base {p} you play each turn has +1{p} and "Damage that would be dealt by this can't be prevented."' Two absent mechanics -- an ordinal over qualifying cards PLAYED each turn, and unpreventable damage scoped to a source, the same gap malign_yellow is tracked for. Blade Break is printed.
